impact_summary.value: FDA는 해당 시설의 제조 방법·시설·관리 체계가 CGMP에 부합하지 않아 약품이 오염된 것으로 간주된다고 설명하며, 위반을 해결하지 않으면 미국 수입 거부 및 신규 신청 승인 보류가 이어질 수 있다고 알립니다.

evidence.quote: Because your methods, facilities, or controls for manufacturing, processing, packing, or holding of drugs as described in your response to our 704(a)(4) request do not conform to CGMP, your drug products are adulterated within the meaning of section 501(a)(2)(B) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act)

affected_work.value: 해당 업체의 OTC 의약품 제조에 사용되는 탈크 원료의 확인·순도·함량·품질 시험과 공급업체 분석성적서 신뢰성 검증, 품질부서의 규격 승인·감독이 대상입니다.

evidence.quote: You have not demonstrated that you appropriately tested incoming talc drug components used in the manufacture of your (b)(4) drug products for identity, purity, strength, and quality.

recommendation.value: FDA는 사용된 모든 탈크 로트의 보관 검체 시험 결과를 제출하고, 검체가 없으면 관련 완제품 배치의 석면 시험을 하도록 요구합니다. 각 원료 로트 시험 및 공급업체 분석성적서 검증 방법, 원료 규격과 약전 간 차이 분석 및 적합 계획, 품질부서 권한·자원 확보를 위한 평가·시정 계획도 회신하도록 요구합니다.

evidence.quote: Identity, assay and impurity test results from testing retains for all lots of talc (drug component) used in the manufacture of your drug products. Alternatively, if a retain of a component lot is unavailable, perform retain sample testing of all implicated finished drug product batches for asbestos. Provide this information within 30 calendar days of the date of this letter.
A description of how you will test each component lot for conformity with all appropriate written specifications for identity, purity, strength, and quality.
In response to this letter, provide a comprehensive assessment and remediation plan to ensure your QU is given the authority and resources to effectively function.
After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days. Specify what you have done to address any violations and to prevent their recurrence.
